enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Strength +13: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Intelligence +13: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Charisma +13: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.

enchantments.tooltip: Greater Auto-Repair: This item has a small percentage chance to cast a Reconstruct spell on you when you take damage.
Repair Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming repair healing by +27 (Insight bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Repair +20: Passive: +20 Competence bonus to the Repair skill.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
